summary: Wellchange Holdings Co Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the appointment of two independent directors: Mr. Lau Yun Chau (re-appointed after a prior resignation) and Mr. Lau Chun. Both appointments were effective June 10, 2026, by board resolution. Mr. Lau Yun Chau receives $7,000 annual compensation. The filing is a routine disclosure of director changes with no forced/abrupt departure or special-situation trigger. The appointments are normal governance actions, not an activist campaign or other event-driven category.
